    - Mf. Not a word about the packet. I have a needle and I know where you live. Roughly.

    - Juna wears green. Always has. Every few years I make a new jacket, and I keep a scrap of each one sewn into my coat lining. Here, feel that. Thirty years of Junas. Only the very first jacket is missing. I have never found a thread of it.
    - Because Dex would take it home, and wear it to supper, and sit on it. The key lives on the ribbon with my spectacles. Fifteen years he has asked. Fifteen years I have said no.
    - And Sprout touched it once. Briefly. He thinks I did not see. I see everything. Mf.
    - The bright stuff comes from Dyna, and I complain about her prices every single time. Lately she has earned some of the complaining: outside cloth is scarce, and her prices are rising for real. I still complain. It is tradition.
